description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Modernize Basket.API caching for Azure-hosted Redis. Addresses issues: Data caching is detected, Connection string is detected.
tasks.reason: Basket.API persists baskets in Redis and currently relies on local cache connectivity assumptions that must be replaced for Azure-hosted operation.
tasks.requirements: Migrate Basket.API basket caching from local Redis assumptions to Azure Cache for Redis, preserve existing basket CRUD behavior and basket serialization, and replace the local Redis connection-string dependency with Azure-compatible authentication and configuration.

tasks.description: Externalize Basket.API runtime configuration for Azure. Addresses issues: Local application configuration detected, Environment variables dependency detected.
tasks.reason: Basket.API currently depends on local appsettings and launch-profile environment values that are not suitable as the primary configuration source in Azure.
tasks.requirements: Move non-secret Basket.API settings from local appsettings files to Azure App Configuration while preserving the current IConfiguration and options binding shape, and define how Azure-hosted execution will supply the launch-profile environment settings that are currently required for local development.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency CVEs before Azure rollout.
tasks.reason: Every modernization plan must validate project dependencies and remove known vulnerabilities before deployment work proceeds.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Runtime environment established by previous modernization tasks and the existing dotnet/MSBuild toolchain.
